page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highcpu-32 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The arm64 architecture offers a hardware profile designed for high resource density and power efficiency. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the c4a-highcpu-32 is engineered for compute-bound workloads. Appropriate use cases include web serving, containerized microservices, distributed analytics, and CI/CD pipelines that benefit from dedicated arm64 processing cores without requiring large memory footprints or local storage.
